instruction: Please apply a yellow background to all slides in the presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing background color to yellow (RGB: 255, 255, 0) on all 19 slides. Uses existing evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance function to verify RGB distance from target color. Original background is white (RGB: 255, 255, 255).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies that yellow background is applied to ALL slides, not just one
Metric function evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance iterates through all slides and calculates average RGB distance
Expected RGB [255, 255, 0] is semantically correct for yellow color
Original RGB [255, 255, 255] is semantically correct for white background
Getter correctly retrieves the PPTX file from VM after task completion
Postconfig appropriately saves the file (Ctrl+S) to ensure changes are persisted before verification
Metric handles both solid fill (type 1) and inherited fill from master (type 5)
Returns normalized similarity score where 1.0 means all slides have yellow background, 0.0 means none do
If slides retain white background, distance calculation returns 1, making final score low (correct failure detection)
Complete coverage: instruction requires 'all slides' and metric verifies all slides
